_help: Letters that float down to the nisse. Keyed by date (MM-DD). A letter arrives on its date, or the first time he's started in the 6 days after. {kid} = Balder, {name} = the nisse's name. Blank lines make new paragraphs; lines starting with '- ' become a list.

11-29.title: To the new Christmas Trainee
11-29.body:
Dear {name},

Congratulations! You have been chosen as a Christmas Trainee this year. Not every nisse gets this chance, so I hope you are wearing your best hat.

Your jobs until Christmas Eve:
- Look in your stocking every day. The workshop may send you things.
- Eat your rice pudding. A hungry nisse makes mischief. (I know. I was young once.)
- Practise your jumps, your dances, and above all being kind.
- Keep {kid} company, but never get in the way of homework.

Every Advent Sunday I will check how you are doing. If all goes well, you will get your very own sleigh licence on Christmas Eve.

I have asked {kid} to keep an eye on you. I hear {kid} is very good at that.

Ho ho ho!
